title: lycopodiella trianae
intro: Lycopodiella trianae, commonly known as Spike-moss, is a species of club moss that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antioxidant properties, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodiella trianae include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
